info.name: AutoParts Admin — Analytics, Disputes and Orders
info.description: Sample requests and response assertions for the platform admin API. Import the companion environment and set your credentials and record IDs. Run Login first. Read folders do not change records. The numbered workflow changes the manually selected OPEN workflowDisputeId through in_review, escalated, resolved and closed; choose a fresh open test dispute for each run. partialAmountKobo must not exceed its order total. Rulings record decisions only. See postman/admin-platform.README.md for sample bodies and expected results. Requests have not been sent to your application database.

Choose an OPEN test dispute for the workflow; use a fresh open dispute when rerunning.
Optional seller filter. Enable that query parameter after setting this.
Positive integer, at most the selected dispute order value; 1000 kobo = NGN 10.
